rows.sourceEnglish: Confirmed orders give information about demand. Their value still depends on reliable supply, payment and the costs of fulfilling them.
rows.before: Ditaelo tse netefaditsweng di fana ka tlhahisoleseding ka demand. Boleng ba tsona bo ntse bo itshetlehile ka reliable supply, tefo le ditjeo tsa ho di phethahatsa.
